messages:
ida: quick heads-up 026-07-08 22:00 UTC planned mini-maint window (60m). scope: rolling cordon+reboot of 6 GPU hosts in az4 to validate nvme tail-latency mitigation. will drain 2 nodes at a time.

omar: confirm which pools are affected and backfill strategy?

ida: affects spot/intermittent only. backfill to warm racks in same region, pre-warm KV prefix after reboot. ordering az4 -> az2 to avoid cross-region egress.

kelly: gate times for prewarm? telemetry checks?

ida: gate: wait up to 3m for cache.prefix.ready per node; if two nodes exceed gate consecutively we pause. capture dmesg and nvme smart-log for correlation.

omar: cost impact estimate?

ida: estimated ~0.25% extra GPU-hours for the hour; finance okayed. link to runbook in ops doc.

infra-bot: scheduled by ida: az4-nvme-mini @ 2026-07-08T22:00:00Z -> 2026-07-08T23:00:00Z. Pager duty: infra-oncall.

kelly: I'll post a short note to #support-ops 30m prior. ida+omar will execute. leaving thread open for live notes.
